documents.name: Mutual NDA
documents.summary: Both sides share confidential information and both are bound to protect it.
documents.use_when: You are about to discuss something sensitive with another company — a partnership, an acquisition, a technical evaluation — before any commercial agreement exists.

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.summary: The primary contract for selling a hosted software service to a business customer.
documents.use_when: You sell SaaS and need the master agreement that everything else — SLA, DPA, AI Addendum — attaches to.

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.summary: Licenses software the customer runs themselves rather than a service you host.
documents.use_when: The customer installs or self-hosts your software, so a cloud service agreement does not fit.

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.summary: Covers consulting, implementation or other services delivered against a statement of work.
documents.use_when: You are being paid for work rather than for a product, with the specifics defined per-SOW.

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.summary: A time-boxed paid trial with a defined success test and a path into a full agreement.
documents.use_when: A prospect wants to prove the product works before committing to an annual contract.

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.summary: Terms for an early customer who shapes a product still being built, usually in exchange for access.
documents.use_when: You are co-developing with a first customer and need feedback, IP and confidentiality settled.

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.summary: Governs a referral or reseller relationship, including who owns the customer and how fees are split.
documents.use_when: Another company will refer or resell your product and the commercial terms need writing down.

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.summary: Uptime commitments, support response times, and the credits owed when they are missed.
documents.use_when: A customer needs a contractual availability guarantee alongside the main agreement.

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.summary: The GDPR-required terms for processing personal data on a customer's behalf.
documents.use_when: Your service handles personal data belonging to a customer's users or employees.

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.summary: The HIPAA terms required when a vendor handles protected health information.
documents.use_when: Your customer is a healthcare entity and your service touches patient data.

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.summary: Settles how AI features may be used, what may be trained on, and who owns the output.
documents.use_when: Your product includes AI features and the base agreement predates them or is silent on them.
